attempted_claim: Let X/Q be a K3 surface of degree 2 with geometric Picard rank 1, Pic(Xbar)=Zh, h^2=2, obtained by the Hassett-Varilly-Alvarado (2,2)-divisor construction, with associated transcendental class alpha in Br(X)[2] of Theorem 1.1 in arXiv:1110.1738 (quaternion class (B^2-4AD,A)). Assume X has good reduction at 2. Determine a necessary and sufficient p-adic Hodge-theoretic condition -- in terms of good ordinary vs non-ordinary reduction of X at 2, respectively the refined Swan / Fontaine-Laffaille / Breuil-Kisin invariant of alpha or of the Kuga-Satake 2-adic representation (equivalently its Emerton-Gee-Selmer condition) -- for the evaluation map ev_{alpha,2}:X(Q_2)->Br(Q_2) to be constant, and in particular decide whether inv_2 alpha = 0 when the reduction is good ordinary with e=1. This is a finite exact constancy-and-value problem, unconditional on any conjecture, replacing the sufficient congruence criterion of Lemma 4.7 by a sharp intrinsic criterion.
decisive_failure: originality: EMERGENT_FINDING genuinely arose from target work testing FL/KS/EG/BN and Hilbert, not evasion. But headline is mechanically implied: (b) uniform refined-Swan iff is verbatim BN Theorem A instantiated at HVA good reduction, independent of polygon by BN formula itself; (a) FL bound is standard p>2 weight-window numerics; (c) mod-8 sensitivity is textbook Q2 Hilbert formula. BN plus Pagano/ANP already establish ordinary is not the controller. Specialization without computing HVA Swan levels is parameter substitution under STANDARD. value: No HVA-specific exact invariant is established: Swan level, residue and beta for alpha are never computed, and no explicit Picard-rank-one HVA surface with good ordinary reduction and opposite inv_2 is exhibited. Restating BN generality, FL textbook bound, and abstract Hilbert table does not give a future worker a retrievable HVA-at-2 fact beyond the cited theorems. This is textbook restatement plus parameter substitution with no computed boundary, census, witness, or usable HVA check, hence not independently valuable under STANDARD.
